name: With no agents open, an idle check-in may hold up a wish
case: The person poked Boop an hour ago, is at the Mac, and no agent is open. At the idle check-in Boop may make its wish: the sign shows it, and the board's bubble with it, though no agent is open.
why: Idle check-ins no longer need an open session, and the wish is the idle beat due (IdleBeat): code deals it, so no Jev is needed
